verdict.rationale: BugSnag's integrations docs say it can "create and sync issues in Jira, or your team's issue tracker," which is a first-party issue-tracker linking capability with some sync. The evidence gives no detail on bidirectional status behavior or which other trackers are covered. Missing for 10: explicit two-way status sync (closing the ticket resolves the error), regression reopening the linked ticket, named GitHub Issues and Linear support, in-depth integration docs, and independent corroboration.
